newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Feb CPI seen around prelim 0.0 pct mo/mo.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Feb CPI seen around prelim 0.0 pct mo/mo.

text.p: Italy's preliminary consumer prices rate for February is estimated at around 0.0 percent month-on-month and 2.3 percent year-on-year after data from six sample cities, economists said.
This compares with a final month-on-month rate of 0.2 percent in January and a year-on-year rate of 2.6 percent.
Analysts had forecast February CPI at 0.2 percent on a monthly basis and 2.5 percent on a yearly basis.
A further five sample Italian cities will publish their preliminary February figures on Friday. Together all 11 cities have a weighting of 75.66 percent on the national index.
Final CPI will be released by national statistics institute Istat on March 4.
